Most people walk right past Ann Cafe & Brunch Phu Quoc hunting street food. Big mistake. This place sits at 7 Đường Lê Thị Hồng Gấm and it hits differently, great coffee, proper brunch plates, and a crowd that actually knows what they're doing. $15-30 a person for a full sit-down meal at a night market. That math is unbeatable.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
